issues.title: Existing OpenClaw session reply initialization conflict
issues.reproduction: OpenClaw session agent:commerce-control:dashboard:893d1459-5c98-4bb3-98c8-79a15f882c0d shows Error: reply session initialization conflicted after an accepted Video Task
issues.rootCause: OpenClaw reply/session path produced accepted task but prior session emitted initialization conflict; fresh session succeeded. Needs regression after final A/B.
issues.closeCondition: Fresh session completes a real A0 without plugin/session conflict; regression recorded.

issues.title: Complex uploaded marketing request lost output contract and was routed as source edit
issues.reproduction: A0 project 14f1e670-3177-4cd9-9d0f-a942fc387a88 stored 1280x720/40 despite 1080x1920/45; routeDecision taskMode recut; title quote triggered uploadedVideoTitle shortcut
issues.rootCause: creative.create defaulted demo output before routing; sourceEditIntent treated any quoted title as source-edit
issues.fix: Infer explicit output constraints in create() and require initialVideoMode(source-edit) for source-edit shortcut

issues.title: 真实上传素材的工程绝对 originalRef 被 safeRelativePath 错误拒绝
issues.reproduction: OpenClaw A0 恢复在规划阶段报素材路径必须相对于 video-agent 工作目录
issues.rootCause: 绝对路径合同只允许 OpenClaw state 根，未允许受管 Video Agent 工程根内 originalRef
issues.fix: safeRelativePath 改为基于 canonical containment 允许 Video Agent 根或显式 state 根，拒绝越界路径
issues.closeCondition: 解锁后同一工程恢复并进入完整创建/渲染，且 path/originalRef/hash 一致

issues.title: 导演模型返回分镜但漏 observations，真实任务在文档校验阻断
issues.rootCause: provider structured output 未返回所选素材的 observation 行
issues.fix: 使用已生成 evidence.json 绑定中性观察记录，保留真实样本/hash，不补写事实
issues.closeCondition: 恢复后分镜校验、渲染和实际观片通过

issues.title: 可选旁白缩短建议不合格时错误阻断整单
issues.reproduction: A0 recovery job-94f64d1b... 在安排整片内容与节奏阶段报 NARRATION_REVISION_INVALID
issues.rootCause: 模型返回的 narrationRevision 未满足新的台词与冲突依据契约，但内部可选优化异常被直接抛出为 recoverable
issues.fix: production.story.plan 对 NARRATION_REVISION_INVALID 保留已生成旁白并继续 timing/渲染，记录 narration-revision-rejected.json；保护/循环错误仍然阻断
issues.closeCondition: 同一 OpenClaw 项目恢复后完成 A0 timing、渲染、实际观片且旁白/字幕/混音存在
